governing_instruments.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Operational Guidelines

decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: Small and marginal landholder farmer family comprising husband, wife and minor children who own cultivable landholding.

decision_driving_rules.plain_en: Bank account must be seeded with Aadhaar
